strings.zh: 喂！和我做个朋友吧！{NEWLINE}喜欢精灵的{CLEAR}是不会有坏人的！{SCROLL}我们以后就多聊聊皮卡丘啊,{NEWLINE}呆呆兽啊,毒刺水母之类的{CLEAR}有关精灵的话题吧！{SCROLL}怎么样？和我交换电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hey, let’s be friends!{NEWLINE}I figure nobody who likes Pokémon{CLEAR}could be a bad person.{SCROLL}Let’s chat about Pikachu and Slowpoke{NEWLINE}and Tentacruel and all kinds of{CLEAR}other Pokémon. It’ll be fun!{CLEAR}What do you think?{SCROLL}Can I get your phone number?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好！以后就多聊聊{NEWLINE}关于精灵的话题吧！
strings.en: Sure thing! If anything{NEWLINE}Pokémon-related comes up, I’ll call!
You...{NEWLINE}I bet you don’t even like Pokémon...

strings.zh: 我们尽情聊聊{NEWLINE}关于精灵的话题吧！{SCROLL}怎么样？和我交换{NEWLINE}电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Let’s chat about Pokémon!{NEWLINE}Can I get your phone number?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 等你好久了,{NEWLINE}来！这个给你！{SCROLL}你就收下吧,{NEWLINE}你的精灵也会很开心的。{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ve been waiting ages for{NEWLINE}you! Here, this is for you!{SCROLL}Go on, take it. Your{NEWLINE}Pokémon will love it, too.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 嗯？{NEWLINE}你就在我附近？{SCROLL}我当然知道了,{SCROLL}因为我看到了你身上散发出的{NEWLINE}对精灵的爱的灵气！{SCROLL}既然就在附近,{NEWLINE}那就直接来找我{CLEAR}聊聊关于精灵的话题吧！
strings.en: What’s that?{NEWLINE}Wait, you’re near me, aren’t you?{SCROLL}I can tell.{SCROLL}How? Because you give off this aura of{NEWLINE}affection for Pokémon!{SCROLL}If you’re nearby, come on and talk to{NEWLINE}me in person about Pokémon stuff!

strings.zh: 听我说,{NEWLINE}我的{VAR:0100:10}{CLEAR}只要我轻轻捏一下它脸蛋,{CLEAR}就会开心地笑起来！{SCROLL}但要是别人去捏的话{NEWLINE}它就不会笑了⋯⋯{CLEAR}是不是我的很特别　啊？{SCROLL}啊！对了,{NEWLINE}前几天皮卡丘打败了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}是{VAR:0100:11}哦！{SCROLL}是不是很厉害啊！！{SCROLL}我的皮卡丘好厉害！{SCROLL}我的皮卡丘天下第一！{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Hey, listen to this.{NEWLINE}My {VAR:0100:10} totally grins when{CLEAR}I pinch its cheek.{SCROLL}But it never grins like that for{NEWLINE}anyone else. I must be special.{SCROLL}Oh, and just now, my Pikachu beat a{NEWLINE}wild {VAR:0100:11}!{CLEAR}A wild {VAR:0100:11}, I’m sayin’!{SCROLL}Yeah, amazing, isn’t it?{SCROLL}My Pikachu is awesome!{SCROLL}My Pikachu is the greatest!{NEWLINE}Talk to you later.

strings.zh: 听我说,{NEWLINE}我的{VAR:0100:10}{CLEAR}只要我轻轻捏一下它脸蛋,{CLEAR}就会开心地笑起来！{SCROLL}但要是别人去捏的话{NEWLINE}它就不会笑了⋯⋯{CLEAR}是不是我的很特别　啊？{SCROLL}啊！对了,{NEWLINE}之前我看到了{CLEAR}一只{VAR:0100:11}⋯⋯{SCROLL}但因为不怎么可爱{NEWLINE}所以放它走了⋯⋯{SCROLL}果然精灵一定要可爱才有人气啊。{SCROLL}再见啦。
strings.en: Hey, listen to this.{NEWLINE}My {VAR:0100:10} totally grins when{CLEAR}I pinch its cheek.{SCROLL}But it never grins like that for{NEWLINE}anyone else. I must be special.{SCROLL}Oh, and I saw a wild {VAR:0100:11} a{NEWLINE}little while ago. But it wasn’t very{CLEAR}cute, so I left it...{SCROLL}Pokémon have to be cute. They’re no{NEWLINE}good otherwise.{SCROLL}Talk to you later.

strings.zh: 你的精灵们最近还好吗？{SCROLL}下次我们好好聊聊{NEWLINE}一些精灵的话题吧！
strings.en: How are your Pokémon doing?{SCROLL}Let’s get together and{NEWLINE}brag about our Pokémon!

strings.zh: 我把金珠送给你吧。{SCROLL}我的皮卡丘可是{NEWLINE}非常喜欢这个的哦。{SCROLL}所以你的精灵{NEWLINE}也肯定会很喜欢的。
strings.en: I’d like you to have a Nugget.{SCROLL}My Pikachu just loves it.{SCROLL}I’m certain your Pokémon will love{NEWLINE}it, too!

strings.zh: 你怎么了？{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3},{CLEAR}你快来吧。
strings.en: What’s wrong?{NEWLINE}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}.{CLEAR}Come and pick this up anytime.

strings.zh: 你记得吗？{NEWLINE}今天是捕虫大会！{SCROLL}你应该也会去吧？{SCROLL}我也要带着皮卡丘{NEWLINE}去参加,我要让大家看看{CLEAR}它的可爱。
strings.en: Did you remember?{NEWLINE}The Bug-Catching Contest is today.{SCROLL}You’re going to go, aren’t you?{SCROLL}I think I’ll participate with Pikachu to{NEWLINE}show off its cuteness.

strings.zh: 今天在自然公园{NEWLINE}会举办捕虫大会。{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}会去吗？{SCROLL}我⋯⋯还在犹豫！
strings.en: The Bug-Catching Contest is at the{NEWLINE}National Park today.{SCROLL}Are you going, {VAR:0103:0}?{NEWLINE}I’m trying to make up my mind.
